cards.headline: US lets 100,000-plus Ukrainians and Sudanese stay as TPS lapses
cards.summary: DHS said migrants from Ukraine and Sudan retain protections after their temporary protected status was set to expire Monday, so more than 100,000 people avoid immediate deportation risk, the Guardian reports.
cards.why_it_matters: It affects the legal status of about 100,000 people living and working in the US.

sources.title: US grants deportation reprieve to migrants from Ukraine and Sudan

cards.headline: Rep. Garcia says ICE officers broke US citizen's arm in Long Beach
cards.summary: Rep. Robert Garcia, a California Democrat, said ICE officers broke a US citizen's arm during an arrest in Long Beach. Video shows a man screaming as agents pin him down; ICE's account was not included in the reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Use-of-force in immigration enforcement is a live dispute involving citizens' rights and local-federal relations.

sources.title: Democratic lawmaker says ICE officers broke US citizen's arm
Man claims arm broken in violent ICE arrest

cards.headline: Gas prices up 37% under Trump, testing Republicans on affordability
cards.summary: Axios reports gas prices are breaking through even among loyal Republican voters, up 37% since President Trump took office after the Iran war. Republicans call the rise temporary but voters may have limited patience.
cards.why_it_matters: Fuel costs touch every household and are a central issue in the midterms.

sources.title: The affordability question Republicans can't escape

cards.headline: BBC Verify examines how the US economy is doing under Trump
cards.summary: Ahead of the midterms, with Trump boasting about economic performance, BBC Verify looks at inflation, jobs and economic growth to test the claims.
cards.why_it_matters: Voters are weighing prices and jobs as they decide on Congress.

sources.title: How is the US economy really doing under President Trump?

cards.headline: Credit insurance trading on Big Tech surges; SoftBank risk at 4-year high
cards.summary: Trading in credit default swaps tied to big tech groups has jumped as investors seek protection against an AI boom unraveling, the FT reports. SoftBank's CDS hit its highest in nearly four years, Bloomberg says.
cards.why_it_matters: Rising hedging costs show lenders worry about AI debt, which can spill into stocks and retirement accounts.

sources.title: AI debt worries spark surge in default insurance trading
SoftBank Credit Risk Hits 4-Year High on AI Funding Strain

cards.headline: Nscale and Anthropic reportedly in talks on $45 billion compute deal
cards.summary: TechCrunch reports Nscale and Anthropic are in talks for another compute deal worth $45 billion, which would add to a string of giant deals Anthropic has struck over the past year. Neither company's confirmation was cited.
cards.why_it_matters: The scale of AI spending is at the center of current market worries over debt.

sources.title: Nscale and Anthropic are reportedly in talks for yet another $45B compute deal

cards.headline: Nvidia plans German startup investments as Merz urges AI adoption
cards.summary: Nvidia announced planned investments in four German startups as Chancellor Friedrich Merz urged businesses at a Berlin industry summit to embrace AI.
cards.why_it_matters: It shows where AI investment is flowing outside the US even as financing worries grow.

sources.title: ‘Open your doors for AI’: German chancellor urges businesses to embrace AI as Nvidia announces new investments

cards.headline: Mamdani says federal government has abdicated on AI
cards.summary: New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani said New Yorkers should reject the idea that an AI takeover is inevitable and demand regulations that protect the public.
cards.why_it_matters: It shows local officials stepping into AI policy as federal rules remain unsettled.

sources.title: Mamdani says feds have abdicated on AI, urges New Yorkers to push back

cards.headline: AI tool predicts cancer survival from a single face photo
cards.summary: Doctors built an AI system that estimates a person's biological age and predicts a cancer patient's survival chances from one photograph of the face, a study suggests.
cards.why_it_matters: It points to cheap risk screening, though a study result is not yet a clinical tool.

sources.title: New AI tool can predict cancer survival by a single patient selfie, study suggests

cards.headline: Pennsylvania warns of congenital measles, unseen in the US for decades
cards.summary: Pennsylvania issued an alert about congenital measles, which can be fatal and requires years of monitoring in survivors. Ars Technica notes the US has not seen it for decades.
cards.why_it_matters: It signals the growing Pennsylvania measles outbreak is reaching newborns.

sources.title: Pennsylvania issues alert on congenital measles—something US hasn't seen for decades

cards.headline: Italy to send 500 troops to Milan after two days of unrest
cards.summary: Italy will deploy 500 army troops to defend Milan after demonstrations over public services and rising costs turned into clashes, looting and vandalism. Luxury shops closed.
cards.why_it_matters: European unrest over living costs is spreading, which weighs on allies' economies and markets.

sources.title: Milan luxury shops close as Italy prepares to deploy troops in the city after days of protests

cards.headline: Albanian protests reach seventh day with nearly 300 injured
cards.summary: Almost 300 people have been injured, more than half of them police, as violent anti-government demonstrations in Albania continue with no sign of easing, the BBC reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Instability in a NATO member adds to political strain on Europe's southeast flank.

sources.title: Seventh day of violent clashes between Albanian protesters and police

cards.headline: Four dead as torrential rain hits eastern Spain
cards.summary: Torrential rain along Spain's Mediterranean coast swept away cars, submerged roads and isolated residents. Four people are reported dead.
cards.why_it_matters: It adds to a deadly flood emergency in a major European tourist destination.

sources.title: Four dead as torrential rain batters eastern Spain

cards.headline: Children among six killed in Russian drone strike on Ukraine park
cards.summary: Al Jazeera reports a Russian drone strike on a park in Ukraine killed six people, including children.
cards.why_it_matters: Russian strikes on civilians continue even as the US and Europe try to restart peace talks.

sources.title: Children among six killed in Russian drone strike on Ukraine park

cards.headline: Iran denies role in plot to kill German Jewish leaders
cards.summary: Tehran summoned Germany's envoy and rejected any role after two men were convicted of trying to kill leaders of Jewish groups in Germany.
cards.why_it_matters: It adds a diplomatic and security dispute with Iran in Europe during the war.

sources.title: Tehran rejects any role in plot to kill leaders of German Jewish groups

cards.headline: Indonesian stocks rebound as authorities answer MSCI warning
cards.summary: Indonesian stocks rebounded after authorities moved to avert a possible two-step MSCI downgrade, though questions remain over whether the measures go far enough.
cards.why_it_matters: An index downgrade could force funds that track emerging-market benchmarks to sell.

sources.title: Indonesia Stocks Rebound as Questions Persist Over Market Fix

cards.headline: Japan's 20-year bond auction draws record demand
cards.summary: Japan's 20-year government bond auction saw the strongest demand on record, a sign elevated yields are luring domestic investors back. Separately, Japanese investors bought the most domestic bonds in 17 years in the fiscal first half.
cards.why_it_matters: Japanese buying affects global yields and the cost of financing for US debt.

sources.title: Japan’s 20-Year Bond Auction Sees Strongest Demand on Record
Japanese Investors Buy Most Domestic Government Bonds Since 2009

cards.headline: GCash owner gains in debut after Philippines' biggest IPO
cards.summary: Mynt, operator of the GCash payments app, rose in its Tuesday debut after the largest IPO in Philippine history. It plans to pursue acquisitions and expand lending.
cards.why_it_matters: A strong debut suggests Asian investors still back fintech even as AI stocks wobble.

sources.title: GCash Owner Gains in Debut After Record Philippines IPO

cards.headline: AirAsia sinks as Malaysia says it has not agreed to aid
cards.summary: AirAsia Group fell to its lowest in almost four years after Malaysia's leader said the country has not agreed to provide financial support to the struggling airline.
cards.why_it_matters: Fuel costs from the Iran war are pressuring airlines worldwide, which can lift fares.

sources.title: AirAsia Drops as Malaysia Says It Hasn’t Agreed to Financial Aid

cards.headline: Myanmar releases rare photos of Aung San Suu Kyi with King Charles gift
cards.summary: Myanmar delivered presents from King Charles to detained former leader Aung San Suu Kyi and released rare photos. Critics said it was a military stunt to end the country's diplomatic isolation.
cards.why_it_matters: The junta is seeking legitimacy while the US holds reported secret talks with its ruler.

sources.title: Myanmar’s ousted leader Aung San Suu Kyi seen in rare photos after receiving gift from King Charles

cards.headline: North Korea shows Kim Jong Un after online death rumors
cards.summary: State media published photos of Kim Jong Un at a clothing and shoe expo with his daughter after unverified rumors of his death spread online. He appeared well.
cards.why_it_matters: Leadership questions in a nuclear-armed state draw global attention, though the rumors were unverified.

sources.title: North Korea releases photos of Kim Jong Un at clothing expo after viral death rumors

cards.headline: Fourteen die in illegal Colombian gold mine collapse
cards.summary: An illegal gold mine collapse in southwestern Colombia killed 14 people and injured seven.
cards.why_it_matters: Illegal mining remains deadly in Latin America and is tied to the global gold trade.

sources.title: Colombia illegal gold mine collapse kills 14 people

cards.headline: Exiled Rwandan president critic found beheaded in Uganda
cards.summary: Ugandan police found a male body in a village near Kampala; the head has not been located. Al Jazeera identifies him as an exiled critic of Rwanda's president.
cards.why_it_matters: Killings of exiled critics raise questions about transnational repression in Africa.

sources.title: Exiled critic of Rwandan president found beheaded in Uganda

cards.headline: US air strikes in Somalia surge, families seek answers
cards.summary: Families describe deaths, injuries and displacement as the Trump administration accelerates US strikes on armed groups in Somalia, Al Jazeera reports.
cards.why_it_matters: It shows the expanding scope of US military action abroad and its civilian toll.

sources.title: The human cost of surging US air strikes in Somalia

cards.headline: IMF sees Africa growing faster than China for first time in decades
cards.summary: The FT reports the IMF expects Africa's GDP to expand faster than China's for the first time in decades, as the continent beat worst expectations after the Iran war.
cards.why_it_matters: Shifting growth affects trade and investment decisions for US firms.

sources.title: Can Africa outgrow China?

cards.headline: Iran war shifts oil power toward the Americas
cards.summary: From Canada to Argentina, investment and production have surged as buyers rush to replace supply lost to Hormuz disruption, the FT reports.
cards.why_it_matters: It could make the US and its neighbors bigger long-term suppliers of oil.

sources.title: Iran war tilts balance of global oil power towards Americas

cards.headline: Louis Vuitton and Hermes among luxury stores looted in French riots
cards.summary: Authorities are working to stop stolen goods from being resold on platforms such as Vinted, Amazon and eBay after looting hit luxury retailers during the riots.
cards.why_it_matters: The unrest is hitting French retail and weighing on French markets.

sources.title: Louis Vuitton and Hermès among luxury retailers looted in French riots

cards.headline: Greg Abbott faces his toughest reelection race in Texas
cards.summary: Gov. Greg Abbott, seeking a fourth term, faces Democrat Gina Hinojosa, who is creeping up in the polls, in a tougher environment for Republicans, the Washington Examiner reports.
cards.why_it_matters: A close race in Texas shows how wide the midterm battleground has become.

sources.title: Greg Abbott, seeking historic fourth term, stares down most competitive race yet: ‘It’s like playing an away game’
